import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from runner import *

def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append((name, got, want))
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("   got :", json.dumps(got))
        print("   want:", json.dumps(want))
    else:
        print("ok:", name)

    base_m = {"host_probe_tx":0,"network_ping_tx":0,"network_ack_tx":0,"host_ack_tx":0,
              "deduplicated_ping":0,"capacity_drops":0,"late_ping":0,"ignored_ack":0,
              "allocations":0,"cache_peak":[],"peak_entries":0,"end_us":0}
    base_m.update(kw)
    return base_m

res = run_ok(d)
expect("S1.rounds", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":0,"source_complete":True,"host_delivery_us":3,"source_proof":[]}])
expect("S1.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, host_ack_tx=1, allocations=1, cache_peak=[1,0], peak_entries=1, end_us=6))

    "unique_observed_classes":0,"ambiguous_observed_classes":0,"path_evidence_lower":0,
    "path_evidence_upper":0,"coverage_status":"no-routes"})
